oVLE3aYk.name: Intro
oVLE3aYk.content: Keyframes for the new-item tint. Each cell is a new row at that moment (Halloumi: someone else's item; Za'atar: your own). The Home · New item frames play this motion live.

PN3UXRv7.name: Section Description
PN3UXRv7.content: The row lands with the list's ROW_LAYOUT spring and the tint fades in with it: bg → accent-soft, 150 ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1)). Several rows: +40 ms per row in list order, capped at 160 ms. The tint then holds, however long it takes, until the row is seen.

49hrIVbp.name: Rule
49hrIVbp.content: • Tint: {color.accent-soft} → {color.bg}, interpolated as a colour on the row fill (the same layer as the press highlight). It spans the row's full inset width (ROW_INSET past the content edge), like the press state.

1DwSOSOD.name: Rule
1DwSOSOD.content: • Someone else's item: fades in with the row, then holds until seen. Items that sync while the row is off screen or the app is closed stay tinted until the row is seen.

gw5HBOmr.name: Rule
gw5HBOmr.content: • Seen: ≥ 50% of the row on screen for 2 s continuously, or on screen when the user leaves the list. Rows off screen, or inside a collapsed section, stay tinted until they're actually seen.

yH52fhC8.name: Rule
yH52fhC8.content: • Own item: starts when the scroll to it settles; hold 300 ms, then fade 1200 ms. No hold-until-seen: the user just added it.

HmTmYgTE.name: Rule
HmTmYgTE.content: • Timing is withTiming throughout (colour change, so no springs). Fade: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin) ≈ cubic-bezier(0.37, 0, 0.63, 1). Fade-in: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) ≈ cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1).

ZG86LRyE.name: Rule
ZG86LRyE.content: • Stagger: 40 ms per row in list order, capped at 160 ms, for both arrival and seen fades.

tMZShoiu.name: Rule
tMZShoiu.content: • Unchecked items only. Checking a tinted item clears the tint at once; nothing is tinted in the Checked section.

yLo7kz7V.name: Rule
yLo7kz7V.content: • Reduced motion: no fade-in; every fade-out becomes a 150 ms linear cross-fade (own item after a 1500 ms hold). Reanimated's ReduceMotion.System would skip withTiming entirely, so pass ReduceMotion.Never with the 150 ms duration.

338962DY.name: Rule
338962DY.content: • Pending dot: unchanged and independent. A tinted row can show the grey dot after its name.

VVzQIxUR.name: Rule
VVzQIxUR.content: • In this file: the rows' css plays the motion. The fade on seen is the data-state "seen" on a tinted row; Home · New item, seen plays it on its own at 2000 ms.

x6VVoHOg.content: One recipe everywhere: 8% ink over whatever is behind (bg, new-item tint, the arrange squircle), in light and dark. Never the same colour as the row press. Replaces Tap's whole-button scale with an icon-only 0.9 squeeze.
x6VVoHOg.name: Notes

lAhlkhNi.content: A translucent ink wash (8% of ink) blooms in while only the icon squeezes to 0.9 and darkens to ink. Reads on any background.
lAhlkhNi.name: Pitch

U0bqG7H5.content: Fill: 90ms in, 180ms out (ease-out). Whole-button scale: off; icon squeezes instead.
